headline: Australian Market Extends Early Strong Losses In Mid-market
summary: The Australian stock market extended its early strong losses in mid-market trade on Friday, adding to the previous session's losses. Moves followed broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight.
why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark equity index, covering the country's largest listed companies and a major share of local institutional portfolios.
why_moved: The index extended losses after broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, adding to the previous session's decline.
